Jauhar Trust's Income Tax Exemption Revoked; Azam Khan Faces Setback

The income tax exemption for the Jauhar Trust, associated with Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan, has been revoked. This decision follows allegations of financial irregularities within the trust. Reports indicate that most of the trust's members are family relatives, and other members allegedly lacked knowledge of its financial activities. This development marks a significant setback for Azam Khan.
